entry.name: ctlout
entry.description: Transmits MIDI continuous controller values to a MIDI device.

arguments.name: port
arguments.description: Specifies the port (a-z) for transmitting MIDI control messages. If there is no argument,initially transmits out port a, on channel 1. When a port is specified by a letter argument, channel numbers greater than 16 received in the right inlet will be wrapped around to stay within the 1-16 range.

arguments.name: device
arguments.description: The name of a MIDI output device may be used as the first argument to specify the port. The name 'none' can be used to prevent the object from transmitting MIDI messages on any port.

arguments.name: ctrllr-channel
arguments.description: Following the (optional) port argument, the next argument is an initial value for the controller number to be used in control messages transmitted by. Controller numbers are automatically limited between 0 and 127. If there is no controller number specified, the initial controller number is 1.Following the controller number argument is an initial value for the channel number on which to transmit control messages. If the channel argument is not present,initially transmits control messages on channel 1. In order for this argument to be used, a controller number argument must precede it.If a port has been specified with a letter argument, channel numbers greater than 16 will be wrapped around to stay within the 1-16 range. If no port argument is present, the channel number specifies both the port and the channel. The exact meaning of the channel number argument depends on the channel offset specified for each port in the MIDI Setup dialog.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Double-clicking on aobject shows a pop-up menu for choosing a MIDI port or device.

messages.name: in1
messages.digest: Set the active MIDI continuous controller number
messages.description: In middle inlet: The number is stored as the controller number of the control change messages transmitted by. Numbers are limited between 0 and 127.

messages.name: in2
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored as the channel number on which to transmit the control messages.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: The number is used as the control value, andtransmits a MIDI control change message. Numbers are limited between 0 and 127.

messages.name: port
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a letteror the name of a MIDI output port or device, specifies the port used to transmit MIDI control messages. The wordis optional and can be omitted. The name 'none' can be used to prevent the object from transmitting MIDI messages on any port.
